speaker: Swami Sivananda
title: Regular and selfless charity
text: Do charity regularly, every month, or even daily according to your means. Never fail in this item. If necessary forego some personal wants but keep up this charity regularly.
modern_interpretation: Consistently contribute to others or worthy causes, whether it's a small daily gesture or a monthly commitment, always within your financial capacity. Make this act of giving a non-negotiable priority in your life. If it means sacrificing some personal luxuries or less essential desires, consider it a small price to pay for maintaining this practice of selfless contribution.
summary: Practice charity regularly according to your means, making it a non-negotiable priority even if it requires sacrificing personal wants.
actionable_advice: Set up a recurring small donation to a cause you believe in, or commit to a weekly act of selfless service in your community.
embedding_ready_text: Swami Sivananda's wisdom from '20 Important Spiritual Instructions' emphasizes the critical importance of 'Regular and selfless charity'. This timeless teaching encourages consistent giving, within one's capacity, and prioritizes selfless contribution even over personal desires. It addresses emotional states like self-centeredness and materialism, fostering compassion, empathy, and inner contentment.
